summary.text: Seth Miller is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives who has represented Strafford 21 since December 2024 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He works as an information technology professional.

paragraphs.text: Seth Miller was born in Gainesville, Florida, and his career experience includes working as an information technology professional.
He assumed office on December 4, 2024, and advanced from the Democratic primary for Strafford 21 on September 8, 2026.
